name: TOGAF EPIC v7 - regulated SAD (TOGAF ADM + BCBS 239 + PRA SS1/23)
description: Contract for scripts/togaf_epic_v7.py. Stands on v6 (full C4 L1-L4, complete ICONIX robustness over every classified object, per-workflow BPMN/UML/robustness, total component coverage) and answers three regulatory findings: (1) fragmented lineage - v7 reads the single Execution Contract Register, which folds five evidence stores, instead of two OpenLineage files; (2) enrichment not evident as a manifest contract - v7 draws, per contract, the object architecture binding contract to declared tasks to executions to the datasets produced and consumed; (3) partial framework alignment - v7 adds the missing TOGAF ADM phases and maps BCBS 239 and PRA SS1/23 control by control, each with a status DERIVED from measured evidence. A control whose evidence is absent is reported NOT MET; an unbuilt probe is a declared gap, never an implied pass.
doctrine: Control status is DERIVED from measured evidence, never asserted. Absent evidence is NOT MET.
Every execution binds to the contract that governed it, and the binding METHOD and CONFIDENCE are recorded so a derived binding is never mistaken for a declared one.
The register reads every rotated ledger segment. A reader that sees only part of its source destroys audit history silently.
Readiness targets are derived from the debt accounting, so a phase cannot read satisfied while work is outstanding.
The model never authors mermaid; code renders every diagram through one budgeted, sharding renderer.
A diagram that overflows the printable box overlaps body text, so svg_over_tall == 0 is part of the PDF gate.
Metric integrity is itself gated (scripts/gates/metric_integrity.mjs): reconciliation, falsifiability, cross-surface consistency, source coverage, path integrity, liveness, and non-empty scope.

frameworks.TOGAF ADM: Preliminary, A-H and Requirements Management, each with evidence and gap
frameworks.BCBS 239: Principles 1-11 (governance, data architecture, accuracy, completeness, timeliness, adaptability, reporting accuracy, comprehensiveness, clarity, frequency, distribution)
frameworks.PRA SS1/23: Principles 1-5 (model identification and tiering, governance, development/implementation/use, independent validation, model risk mitigants)
